Housing Equity 
In January 2021, Amazon launched the Amazon Housing Equity Fund 
,  
a commitment of over $2 billion to preserve and create more than 
20,000 affordable homes in three communities where we have a high 
concentration of employees: Washington state’s Puget Sound region; 
Washington, D.C., and Arlington, Virginia; and Nashville, Tennessee. 
As of March 2022, the Amazon Housing Equity Fund has had a 
significant, positive impact on rental affordability, with more than 
$1.2 billion in loans and grants committed. These commitments 
have protected or created 8,000 affordable units to house more than 
18,000 people. 
Learn more about our progress in our Housing Equity Fund 
Impact Report 
.
